code_checks.intervention_mode_help: none=fixed alpha, predictive=trigger on canary metric, reactive=trigger on downstream metric
code_checks.intervention_logic: Both modes use identical logic: monitor --intervention_metric for gen-over-gen relative drop > --intervention_threshold. When triggered, alpha switches from --synthetic_ratio to --intervention_alpha.
code_checks.reactive_metric_note: distinct_1 is a valid downstream metric (computed in metrics.py via compute_distinct_n). For reactive mode, distinct_1 dropping >15% gen-over-gen triggers intervention.
